d:
A monstrous, spectral entity with glowing, piercing pale-yellow eyes set into a dark, void-like face. The head is topped with a crown of jagged, obsidian-black horns and wisps of ethereal, smoke-like hair in deep violet. The body is a massive, hulking frame of shadow and armor with four-clawed hands and a long, blade-like tail of dark energy. A heavy set of jagged, dark-purple plate armor covers the torso and limbs.
BODY COLOR: obsidian-black
